faq: Which email and SMS tools do you work with?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend, Shopify Email, Brevo and most major tools. Tell us what you use in the order form, and we confirm that we can work in it before the order starts.
Can I import my old contact list?

Yes, if the people agreed to hear from you. We import only contacts with a clear opt-in, and we do not load bought, scraped or rented lists, because that damages your sending reputation and breaks the rules.
Do you need my store login?
No. You invite us as staff or a collaborator in your store and tool, with limited access. We never ask for your passwords, and you can remove us whenever you like.
Does list setup include sending emails?
No. This builds the foundation. Flows, campaigns and forms are separate services, so you can add them to this one or order them later.
